'''Lanos''' was a location within [[Lanos system/Legends|Lanos system]]<ref name="Atlas" /> located in the [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]]<ref name="The Slice" /> and [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was situated in the [[Tandon sector/Legends|Tandon sector]]<ref name="Atlas Online" /> along the [[Askar Trace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]].<ref name="Atlas" /> 

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Wild Space Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]</ref> Lanos was the site of a [[Battle of Lanos|battle]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Atlas" />  when the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] captured the system from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Afterwards, a detachment of Confederacy [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid forces]] occupied Lanos. The action was described by some on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] as liberating Lanos from its crushing servitude to the corrupt Republic. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] briefly discussed the occupation of Lanos and its HoloNet characterizations while reviewing the state of the war.<ref name="Wild Space" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
Lanos was mentioned in ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2008]].<ref name="Wild Space" />
